project_summary: Auto turns narration, captions (SRT/VTT/JSON), script and pictures into a timed picture video and exports MP4 on Android (Media3 Transformer). :core is pure Kotlin tested against Python reference outputs; :app is Compose. The Android app is being redesigned as a premium video-editing app. Desktop project Auto_Desktop_srt_driven is reference only and must not be modified.

known_bugs: Preview drag/resize hit boxes are approximations
Share SRT/VTT sends text, not a file
Looping music fade may restart per loop (processor resets at flush)
Assumptions untested: overlay/effect presentationTimeUs, RgbMatrix on letterboxed pictures, weights below API 28
important_technical_decisions: Base is mobile-editor-ui; its editor is kept, not replaced
No control that does nothing: unavailable tools are tagged Soon and explain themselves
Shell uses the existing palette C so the app looks consistent; the original brief asked charcoal + violet, so that is an open decision (step 18)
Export options come only from core ExportOptions (tested); every new logic goes in :core with a CheckNN test
Editor page is full screen with its own tabs; the bottom bar shows on Home and Settings only
Effects limited to what Media3 1.3.1 renders (brightness, contrast, saturation, opacity); blur/sharpen/vignette/dissolve/wipe are UNAVAILABLE
Transitions are entrances at the start of a picture; FADE also fades the previous picture out
Narration is never trimmed or offset; music starts at 0 and loops or stops; no video clips, no narration split
Font weights other than Regular/Bold need Android 9+ (FontCatalog.offeredWeights)
Palette: change VALUES of object C in Theme.kt to DesignTokens, keep names
